represent the containment of other elements without altering

There must be a special card called `Note` that allows the
capture of arbitrary text and annotates an existing node in the
model without modifying it or the model. The `Note` card must
have only one incoming link from the card it modifies.
Tools MUST be able to load one or more Aurora models from disk

Tools MUST persist Aurora models to disk in a stable,

Tools MUST perform file operations safely (prevent
